answer_4.quote: We invited 30 coworkers for in-house evaluation ... recruited 105 lay testers via Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) for crowdsourcing evaluation. ... For the question "Is the predicted triple correct?" we utilized a scale of 3 options ... We ask the following questions to each tester: • Is the predicted triple correct? (Two scales, see below) • How confident is the assessment? (Scale: 5 point Likert) • Is an explanation helpful? (Scale: yes and no)
answer_4.guideline: Ask testers: Is the predicted triple correct? How confident is the assessment? Is an explanation helpful? Measure accuracy rate, number of helpful explanations, time cost, and confidence level.
